author: official
summary: Counts down to a deadline in the visitor’s browser — typed on the element, or read from an events feed as the next event — as plain digits or split-flap cards, and hides or swaps itself at the deadline.

attributes.name: data-deadline
attributes.description: ISO date-time WITH an explicit offset (Z or ±hh:mm) naming a real date; otherwise the root is left as authored. With data-src it is the fallback, used when the feed gives no event to count to.

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: An events feed URL (the events coral’s feed). The root makes one GET to it on load and counts to the first event still ahead, instead of to a typed data-deadline. Without it the root makes no network call.

attributes.name: data-count-to
attributes.description: With data-src: which moment of the event is the deadline. An event with no end is counted to its start; an all-day event’s end is the midnight after its last day.

attributes.name: data-offset
attributes.description: With data-src: the UTC offset (Z or ±hh:mm) that all-day and floating events are read in. Without it those events are passed over; an event the feed gives in UTC needs none.

attributes.name: data-event
attributes.description: With data-src, on a child element: replace its text with that field of the event being counted to. An empty field leaves the element as authored.

attributes.name: data-event-href
attributes.description: With data-src, on a child link: set its href from the event. location is the location itself when it is an http(s) URL and otherwise a map search for it; url is the event’s own URL. Only http(s) is ever written; otherwise the link is left as authored.

attributes.name: data-expired
attributes.description: What the root does at the deadline: hide it, or replace its content with data-expired-text (text without a data-expired-text hides).

attributes.name: data-expired-text
attributes.description: Text shown in place of the countdown when data-expired is text.

attributes.name: data-part
attributes.description: On a child element: which unit it shows, two digits minimum and as many as needed (no upper bound). The largest unit present also carries every unit above it (hours alone show 53 for 2 d 5 h).

attributes.name: data-flip
attributes.description: On a data-part element: show one split-flap card per digit instead of plain text. data-flip="false" keeps plain text.

attributes.name: data-flip-faces
attributes.description: On a data-flip element: comma-separated faces its cards can show. Every card is locked to the widest of them. It only sizes the cards: with data-flip-mode="drum" the wheel is still 9, 8, … 0, so the default written out behaves exactly like leaving it out.

attributes.name: data-flip-mode
attributes.description: On a data-flip element: drum makes each card a counter wheel that only turns forward (always 9, 8, … 0), folding through every digit in between — the tens of the seconds go 0→9→8→7→6→5 at the minute. Unset keeps the straight-to-target flip. Reduced motion always goes straight.
